title: 3Feed
tagline: Decentralized paid newsletter, based off RSS and other decentralized feed  systems.
description: This project is intended to be an RSS for the decentralized (past advertising) web. The current (MVP) implementation is a publishing/reading platform that allows Creators to write and publish content, with the option to lock the content behind a contract paywall. Users can subscribe to feeds, with full access to the free articles, and the option to pay for the premium articles. Full demo here https://share.vidyard.com/watch/skAVHnYZU9C94ft2YHuJBE?
how_its_made: This project uses Ceramic to handle the document management and hosting with IPFS. Additionally Ceramic is used for the Decentralized Identifiers, which are how content creators are identified. The premium (paid) content is locked using the Unlock Protocol, with all necessary actions (aside from wallet approvals) being handled by 3Feed.
